content.title: LEMO-OPUSCAR
content.subtitle: 39 film styles. your story.
content.prompt: Make a one-minute film in the Whiteboard Explainer style: how to use Lemo-Opuscar.
content.answer: English voice-over, subtitles in English and Chinese. Nothing of my own. Yes, show me the storyboard.
content.reply: Got it: a one-minute whiteboard explainer, calm English voice, bilingual subtitles, storyboard first. Starting now.
question_lines: Before I start, one round of questions:
2. Your own voice, music, photos or fonts? If not, I'll make them.
3. Do you want to review a storyboard first? (Default: no.)
content.storyboard: Storyboard. 12 key shots in the real style, about 70s. What I'm least sure about: the loop at the end. Approve, or tell me what to change.
captions: Thirty-nine film styles.
39种影片风格。
Each one directed, drawn and scored by an AI agent, in code.
每一支都是 AI Agent 用代码执导、作画、配乐。
This is Lemo-Opuscar. Here's how to make your own film, with Claude Opus 5.5.
这是 Lemo-Opuscar。用 Claude Opus 5.5，你也能做一支。
Install it once, as a skill in Claude Code. Or just clone the repo.
先装一次：在 Claude Code 里装成 skill，或者直接 clone 仓库。
Watch the example films, and pick a style.
看样片，挑个风格。
We'll take this one: Whiteboard Explainer.
我们就选这个：白板讲解。
Open any folder in the Claude app, choose Opus 5.5, and say one line.
在 Claude 桌面应用打开任意文件夹，选 Opus 5.5，说一句话。
It asks you once: your material, your voice, and whether you want a storyboard.
它只问你一次：有没有素材，要什么声音，要不要看分镜。
Answer once. From there, it works on its own.
回答一次，之后它自己干活。
Ask for a storyboard, and it stops once to show you the key shots.
要了分镜，它就停一次，给你看关键镜头。
Then it records the voice, writes the music, draws every frame, and mixes the film.
然后录声音，写音乐，画每一帧，再混音。
Yes. That's how the film was made.
没错，这支片子就是这么做的。
Say one line. Answer once. Get your film.
说一句话，回答一次，收片。

attribution.audio: Original audio used for comparison; ownership remains with its creator

limitations: The tutorial's original source timeline was not recovered. Licensed whiteboard engine and EMS lettering are reused with attribution; tutorial layout, camera, UI and writing schedule are independently reconstructed.
Artwork uses standalone official gallery posters plus independently drawn wave and umbrella motions. Gallery sample frames and original painting animation are not identical.
No original full-screen screenshot or source video is played by the runtime.
On-screen product counts, software versions, installation commands and production-time claims are copied reference content, not independently validated instructions.
Chinese subtitles prefer the Windows SimSun system font (not redistributed), with bundled Noto Sans JP as portable fallback.

portable_demo.textures: Original replaceable schematic assets; not the original reference artwork.
portable_demo.approval: Historical motion implementation; this portable demo is not user-approved.
